content.short: Illuvium is a Web3 role-playing game where players capture Illuvials and battle to earn rewards.
content.description: Illuvium is an upcoming Ethereum-based role-playing game where players earn rewards through gameplay. The game lets you capture NFT creatures called Illuvials, which become stronger as you win battles. Players earn ILV, the in-game token, as a reward for progress and victories. Illuvials can be bought, sold, or traded on Illuvium’s NFT marketplace IlluviDEX. To improve performance and cut costs, the game runs on a layer-2 NFT solution that provides gas-free transactions and smoother battles and exploration.
